instruction: Search for the arXiv paper about Falcon language models published on September 27, 2023, and add it to row 4 of the spreadsheet with title, link, and the publication date 2023.9.27 in column C.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding a Falcon paper from Sept 27, 2023 and adding it to row 4 with title, link, and publication date. The evaluator checks all three elements in row 4: (1) title in column A (must contain 'falcon' or 'language model'), (2) link in column B (must be an arXiv URL), and (3) date in column C (must be '2023.9.27' with flexible format matching). Partial credit is awarded with 1/3 score for each verified element.

Proper verification logic: Metric function check_row4_falcon_paper__918676b6 validates all three elements with appropriate partial credit (1/3 each)

Title validation: Verifies title contains expected keywords ('falcon', 'language model') with fallback partial credit for non-empty titles
